_comment: Feeds the importer (npm run jobs:import). Only sources that permit republication belong here:
USAJOBS is public domain, and Lever/Greenhouse board APIs are published by the employer for syndication.
Never add Indeed, ZipRecruiter or LinkedIn - their terms forbid it, they block it, and Google dedupes
aggregated copies against the original so the pages would not rank anyway.
Verified 2026-09-18: dental practices are mostly small businesses and are rarely on Lever/Greenhouse,
so expect a trickle. Probe a new slug with https://api.lever.co/v0/postings/<slug>?mode=json before adding it.

usajobs.note: 0681 is the federal Dental Assistant occupational series. Needs USAJOBS_API_KEY and USAJOBS_EMAIL in .env (free key from developer.usajobs.gov). Federal roles must be applied for on USAJOBS, so the importer sets `official` on them.
